text: The Corporations Nominating Panel will select candidates to be interviewed for appointment to the Toronto Hydro Board. The Corporations Nominating Panel will conduct interviews at its next meeting and recommend seven candidates, including a Chair, to City Council for appointment.

The Corporations Nominating Panel: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview for appointment to the Toronto Hydro Board: Candidate THY2-526 Candidate THY2-376 Candidate THY2-489 Candidate THY2-494 Candidate THY2-488 Candidate THY2-534 Candidate THY2-425 Candidate THY2-482 Candidate THY2-533 Candidate THY2-455 Candidate THY2-495 Candidate THY2-475 Candidate THY2-514 Candidate THY2-516 Candidate THY2-517 Candidate THY2-522 Candidate THY2-462 Candidate THY2-409 Candidate THY2-504 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1a, 1b, and 2 to the report (May 6, 2024) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Hydro Board.
